## Read in Libraries 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(tidycensus)
library(scales)
```

## Read in data

```{r}
SAM <- st_read(here("oahu_solar_dedup_simple.geojson"))

hf_token <- Sys.getenv("HF_TOKEN")
```

## Map the data

```{r}
mapview(SAM)
```

## Retrieve census data

```{r}
library(tidycensus)

oahu_median_household_income <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variable = "B19013_001",
  state = "HI",
  county = "Honolulu",
  geometry = TRUE,
  year = 2022)

```

```{r}
mapview(oahu_median_household_income,
        zcol = "estimate")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = oahu_median_household_income,
       aes(x = moe, y = estimate)) + 
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

## Homework

```{r}
income_sf <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = "B19013_001",   # median household income
  state     = "HI",
  county    = "Honolulu",
  year      = 2022,
  geometry  = TRUE,
  survey    = "acs5"
) %>%
  rename(median_income = estimate, income_moe = moe) %>%
  filter(!is.na(median_income))
```

```{r}
solar_sf <- st_read("oahu_solar_dedup_simple.geojson", quiet = TRUE)
```

## #4

```{r}
# Project to UTM 4N (meters) so areas are in m²
SAM <- SAM %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(32604) %>%
  mutate(
    poly_id = row_number(),
    area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))
  )
```

```{r}
glimpse(SAM)
```

## #5

```{r}
glimpse(oahu_median_household_income)

nrow(SAM)
```

```{r}
oahu_median_household_income %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(n_tracts = n(),
            n_missing = sum(is.na(estimate)),
            min_income = min(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_income = median(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_income = max(estimate, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
oahu_bbox <- st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -158.35, xmax = -157.6, ymin = 21.2, ymax = 21.8),
  crs = 4326
) %>% st_as_sfc()

med_income_cen <- oahu_median_household_income %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  filter(st_within(st_centroid(geometry), oahu_bbox, sparse = FALSE)[, 1]) %>%
  rename(median_income = estimate, income_moe = moe) %>%
  st_transform(32604) %>%
  mutate(tract_area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)))

nrow(oahu_median_household_income); nrow(med_income_cen)
```

```{r}
ggplot(med_income_cen) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = median_income), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", labels = dollar,
                       na.value = "grey80", name = "Median\nincome") +
  labs(title = "Median Household Income by Census Tract",
       subtitle = "Oahu, ACS 5-year 2022",
       caption = "Grey = no income estimate") +
  theme_void()
```

## #6

```{r}
solar_by_tract <- SAM %>%
  st_centroid() %>%
  st_join(med_income_cen %>% select(GEOID)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(GEOID)) %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(
    solar_area_m2 = sum(area_m2),
    n_polygons    = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

nrow(solar_by_tract)   # tracts with at least one polygon
```

```{r}
tracts_solar <- med_income_cen %>%
  left_join(solar_by_tract, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(
    solar_area_m2 = replace_na(solar_area_m2, 0),
    n_polygons    = replace_na(n_polygons, 0)
  )

summary(tracts_solar$solar_area_m2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(tracts_solar) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = solar_area_m2), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", labels = comma,
                       name = "Solar area\n(m²)") +
  labs(title = "Solar Infrastructure Area by Census Tract",
       subtitle = "Oahu, SAM3 predictions, all polygons") +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
ggplot(tracts_solar) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = solar_area_m2 + 1), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", trans = "log10", labels = comma,
                       name = "Solar area\n(m², log)") +
  labs(title = "Solar Infrastructure Area by Census Tract (log scale)",
       subtitle = "Oahu, SAM3 predictions, all polygons") +
  theme_void()
```

## #7

```{r}
tracts_norm <- tracts_solar %>%
  mutate(
    solar_pct_area = solar_area_m2 / tract_area_m2 * 100
  )

summary(tracts_norm$solar_pct_area)
```

```{r}
pop_hh <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = c(population = "B01003_001",
                households = "B11001_001"),
  state = "HI",
  county = "Honolulu",
  year = 2022,
  survey = "acs5",
  output = "wide",
  geometry = FALSE
) %>%
  select(GEOID, population = populationE, households = householdsE)
```

```{r}
tracts_norm <- tracts_norm %>%
  left_join(pop_hh, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(
    solar_m2_per_hh  = if_else(households > 0, solar_area_m2 / households, NA_real_),
    solar_m2_per_cap = if_else(population > 0, solar_area_m2 / population, NA_real_)
  )
```

```{r}
summary(tracts_norm$solar_m2_per_hh)
```

```{r}
###PUT THEM ALL TOGETHER
library(patchwork)

p_raw <- ggplot(tracts_norm) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = solar_area_m2 + 1), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", trans = "log10", labels = comma,
                       name = "m²") +
  labs(title = "Raw solar area") +
  theme_void()

p_pct <- ggplot(tracts_norm) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = solar_pct_area), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", name = "% of tract") +
  labs(title = "Solar as % of tract area") +
  theme_void()

p_hh <- ggplot(tracts_norm) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = solar_m2_per_hh), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", na.value = "grey80", name = "m² / hh") +
  labs(title = "Solar m² per household") +
  theme_void()

p_raw + p_pct + p_hh
```

## #8

```{r}
# Percentiles and a size-class breakdown
quantile(SAM$area_m2, probs = c(.5, .75, .9, .95, .99, .999))
```

```{r}
SAM %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(size_class = cut(area_m2,
                          breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 5000, Inf),
                          labels = c("<25", "25-50", "50-100", "100-250", "250-500",
                                     "500-1k", "1k-5k", ">5k"))) %>%
  group_by(size_class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            total_m2 = sum(area_m2),
            pct_of_polygons = n() / nrow(SAM) * 100,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pct_of_total_area = total_m2 / sum(total_m2) * 100)
```

```{r}
ggplot(SAM, aes(area_m2)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", color = "grey") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(100, 250, 500, 1000), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
mapview(SAM %>% filter(area_m2 > 250 & area_m2 <= 1000),
        map.types = "Esri.WorldImagery", col.regions = "yellow", layer.name = "250-1000 m²") +
  mapview(SAM %>% filter(area_m2 > 1000),
          col.regions = "red", layer.name = ">1000 m²")
```

## #9

```{r}
clusters_sf <- SAM %>%
  st_buffer(10) %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
  st_sf(cluster_id = seq_len(length(.)), geometry = .)
```

```{r}
SAM$cluster_id <- st_intersects(st_centroid(SAM), clusters_sf) %>%
  map_int(~ .x[1])
```

```{r}
cluster_summary <- SAM %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  summarise(n_polys = n(),
            cluster_area_m2 = sum(area_m2),
            max_poly_m2 = max(area_m2),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
#many polygons or one big one?
cluster_summary %>%
  arrange(desc(cluster_area_m2)) %>%
  head(15)
```

## #10

```{r}
SAM_res <- SAM %>% filter(area_m2 <= 500)
```

```{r}
# SUM of solar area per tract
solar_by_tract <- SAM_res %>%
  st_centroid() %>%
  st_join(med_income_cen %>% select(GEOID)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(GEOID)) %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(solar_area_m2 = sum(area_m2), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
# Combine income into one dataframe
tracts_model <- med_income_cen %>%
  left_join(solar_by_tract, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(solar_area_m2 = replace_na(solar_area_m2, 0)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(median_income))
```

```{r}
ggplot(tracts_model, aes(x = median_income, y = solar_area_m2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = dollar) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Median household income", y = "Solar area") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
nrow(tracts_model)
```

```{r}
cor.test(tracts_model$median_income, tracts_model$solar_area_m2)
```
